# dokploy_server (Data Source)

Fetches a single server from Dokploy by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The server name to look up. Mutually exclusive with server_id.
- `server_id` (String) The server ID to look up. Mutually exclusive with name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the server.
- `description` (String) The description of the server.
- `enable_docker_cleanup` (Boolean) Whether Docker cleanup is enabled.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the server (same as server_id).
- `ip_address` (String) The IP address of the server.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID the server belongs to.
- `port` (Number) The SSH port of the server.
- `server_status` (String) The current status of the server.
- `server_type` (String) The type of the server (e.g., deploy).
- `ssh_key_id` (String) The SSH key ID used to connect to the server.
- `username` (String) The SSH username for the server.
